expect.offline: The date parts come from $now, so the page path follows the run's clock; the route answers any path on www.gocomics.com. Information Extractor (OpenAI chat model) pulls the strip's image URL from the HTML, OpenAI's image analysis reads that URL directly (n8n does not download it) and writes the dialogue in English and Korean, and the Discord post carries the date, the URL and that text. Both model replies are recorded at run time.
